status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 50% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Golan Heights and Aleppo.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 50 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Golanhøydene og Aleppo.

summary.en: ISIL suicide bombers attacked security facilities in Hasakah, killing two Syrian security force members, and carried out a suicide attack in northeastern Syria that killed two security personnel. Iran launched missiles at militants in Syria in response to a parade attack, while the UAE, Jordan, Egypt and other regional states condemned recent attacks on Syrian security forces. Syrian authorities are replacing Russian Kalashnikovs with Turkish KCR556 rifles for their security forces. Tourists are beginning to return to Syria. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: ISIL-selvmordsbomber angrep sikkerhetsanlegg i Hasakah og drepte to medlemmer av de syriske sikkerhetsstyrkene, og gjennomførte et selvmordsangrep i nordøst-Syria som drepte to sikkerhetspersonell. Iran skjøt missiler mot militante i Syria som svar på et paradeangrep, mens De forente arabiske emirater, Jordan, Egypt og andre regionale stater fordømte de siste angrepene på syriske sikkerhetsstyrker. Syriske myndigheter erstatter russiske Kalashnikov-rifler med tyrkiske KCR556‑rifler for sine sikkerhetsstyrker. Turister begynner å vende tilbake til Syria. UCDP registrerte 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
